_note: 主题预设：一份数据，零代码新增主题。新增一个节日只需往 themes 里加一条。
🔴 提示词**不能写死具体文案**：底板资源每张的文字都不一样（8-DAY / 50x Rebate / …）。
早期版本把「8-DAY」「Login Premium Gift」写进 prompt，换一张图就会把旧文案画上去。
现在改为模板拼装：layout（构图锁，通用规则或 --layout 传入）+ theme 字段（配色/装饰/服装/空区）。
themes 字段语义：
zh/en       中文名 / 英文主题名（进 prompt）
suffix      产出文件名后缀
palette     配色（给人看的，也打印在环节日志里）
decoration  装饰元素（给人看的）
text_style  原文字的材质/描边处理（只改材质，不改字）
outfit      角色服装改成什么样（姿势/位置/缩放不许动）
body        大片空白卡体（给 UI 覆盖层用）换成什么质感
banner      顶部横幅底色
decor_sentence 替换掉原装饰的句子
providers: manual=人/Agent 出图后丢进 inbox；chatgpt_web=浏览器 cookie 驱动 chatgpt.com；
任何能写文件的模型都可以用 manual 接入，本文件不绑定具体厂商。
body_colors: 长条底板（banner + 大片空白区）的续接渐变两端色，postprocess --hero-band 用。
composition（构图自由度，--composition 或 COMPOSITION=）：lock=人物姿势/位置/缩放全锁，只换衣服与配色（默认，可预期）；
free=允许重设计人物姿势与镜头换吸引力，但**仍然锁死**文案完整可读、底部 UI 空白区、画布比例与透明边。
free 用 layout_free，lock 用 layout_default；主题可用 pose_hint 给 free 模式一个推荐姿势。
layout_default: 1) Every existing piece of text (headline, numerals, captions, badges, ribbons) keeps the EXACT same wording, spelling, position, scale and weight as the input image. Only its color/material may shift to the new palette. Do NOT add, remove, reword or re-typeset any text.
2) The illustrated character keeps the same pose, position, scale and silhouette; only the outfit, accessories and small props are restyled.
3) The large empty body area reserved for UI overlays stays empty with the same shape and margins - no text, no clutter, no ornaments in the center.
4) Keep the original canvas aspect ratio, framing, bleed and rounded-corner silhouettes.
layout_free: 1) Every piece of text keeps the EXACT same wording, spelling and language as the input image - no added, removed or reworded words, and every glyph must stay complete, sharp and fully readable. You may re-position or re-scale the text block for a better composition, but it must stay in the upper banner area, inside the canvas and inside the safe margins (nothing clipped at the edges, nothing hidden behind the character).
2) The character may be completely re-posed and re-framed (see CHARACTER), but her face must stay clearly visible and must never cover the text.
3) The large empty body area reserved for UI overlays stays empty with the same shape and margins - no text, no character parts, no clutter, no ornaments in the center of the panel.
4) Keep the original canvas aspect ratio, the same bleed and the same rounded-corner / card silhouettes; every transparent region stays transparent.
